attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "This deletes the shared data protection key blob on any tenant removal, but since Azure blob data protection is typically configured at the application/shell-host level (shared across tenants unless per-tenant containers are used), removing one tenant could delete keys still in use by other tenants or the default tenant, breaking cookie/token decryption application-wide."}

reason: This deletes the shared data protection key blob on any tenant removal, but since Azure blob data protection is typically configured at the application/shell-host level (shared across tenants unless per-tenant containers are used), removing one tenant could delete keys still in use by other tenants or the default tenant, breaking cookie/token decryption application-wide.
